newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil barges move to top of week's range.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil barges move to top of week's range.

text.p: European high sulphur fuel oil barges ticked up on Thursday to the week's top range, but traders were mixed on the sustainability of the rise, with some saying good demand and tight cargoes will push it up further and others seeing a downside.

High sulphur fuel barges traded at $85.50 and $86 fob Rotterdam, in two purchases of 1,000 tonnes each both done by a major, following earlier deals at $84.50 and $85. These compared with Wednesday's range of $84/$85.25.
The highest figure achieved this week has been $86, which has roughly been the top of the range recently.
The buyer said the reason for purchasing at higher numbers were a shortness of material coupled with high bunker demand, over 20,000 tonnes.

"People are seeing that cargoes are getting tighter and tighter and the market is rising. If demand continues then people will be short...I am even considering to buy at $87," a trader with the major said.
However other market players were less enthusiastic, saying demand was on the low side.
